# axiz-core-observability

Observation conventions, standard attributes and helpers for framework spans and structured events.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-observability</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ArchitectureObservation` | Creates the framework spans at architecture points (use case, command, query, event handler, outbox, saga step...). |
| `AttributeSanitizer` | Protects span attributes and structured events from personal data: denied keys are dropped and values that look like card numbers or email addresses are redacted. |
| `AxizAttributes` | Standard attribute keys. |
| `AxizObservations` | Names of the observations (spans and timers) created by the framework at architecture points. |
| `LoggingStructuredEventEmitter` | Emits structured events to the `axiz.event` logger and to the current observation. |
| `Outcomes` | Classifies the result of an operation into the standard outcome values. |
| `StructuredEvent` | Structured event written as a JSON log line and as an event on the current span. |
| `StructuredEventEmitter` | Port to emit structured events; the observability starter logs them and adds span events. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-observability verify`.
